notes: v4 desk switches. Read by retire.py (retirements, Kronos) and v4 modules. config/policy.json stays frozen for the main v3 ledger and is not read for any of this.

legacy_forward_tests.old: legacy forward test (not from a published source)

legacy_why: Nick, 2026-10-31: keep the `old` ledger (policy_old.py, frozen 2026-10-28.3 rules) opening paper trades exactly as before, shown next to the v4 ledgers with the same metrics.
retired_why: docs/STRATEGY_PLAN.md section 1: no edge over matched random entries on the desk's own data (v3, ORBX, lab families), or rules that pay the IV crush (earn_pre). Code and history are kept; open trades are still managed to their exit.
kronos_why: Kronos forecasts are off by default in v4 (STRATEGY_PLAN section 1). The KRONOS=1 environment switch alone no longer starts it; this flag must also be true.
fomc_source: Federal Reserve 2026 FOMC meeting calendar (second day of each meeting = statement day). Used only when config/events.json has no calendar for the day. Verify against federalreserve.gov before relying on it.
